description: CRUD operations on a COMP operator's .storage dictionary. Actions: list (all keys+values), get (one key), set (write a key), delete (remove a key). No operators are created; the target COMP must already exist.

action.description: 'list' returns all keys+values; 'get' reads one key; 'set' writes one key; 'delete' removes one key.

key.description: Storage key. Required for get/set/delete; omit for list.

path.description: Full path of the COMP whose storage dict to operate on.

value.description: Value to store under 'key'. Required for set. Must be JSON-serialisable (string, number, bool, list, dict, null).

name: manage_component_storage
title: Manage Component Storage
